scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @sao/api" "npm run dev -w @sao/web"
scripts.tunnel: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const re = /https:\/\/[^\s]+\.trycloudflare\.com/; const child = spawn('npx', ['wrangler', 'tunnel', 'quick-start', 'http://localhost:5173'], { shell: true, stdio: ['inherit', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const emit = (text) => { process.stdout.write(text); const match = text.match(re); if (match) { console.log('\nTUNNEL_URL=' + match[0]); } }; child.stdout.on('data', (d) => emit(d.toString())); child.stderr.on('data', (d) => emit(d.toString())); child.on('exit', (code) => { if (code && code !== 0) process.exit(code); });"
